create_option_result_success: create an OptionResult with TerminationType.SUCCESS to signal a successful option termination
create_option_result_failure: create an OptionResult with TerminationType.FAILURE to signal a failed option termination
use_termination_type_enum: use the TerminationType enum to check if an episode ended in SUCCESS, FAILURE, or PREEMPTED
generate_unique_uid: use UidGenerator to generate incrementing unique integer IDs for Option instances
create_identity_action_space: create an IdentityActionSpace with a dm_env spec to pass actions through unchanged
